rule.name: SpringTypedConfiguration
rule.message: Read configuration through a @ConfigurationProperties record and pass the values in through constructors or parameters, not @Value, System.getenv, System.getProperty or Environment.getProperty. JVM properties such as java.*, user.*, javax.*, jdk.* and http.* are fine.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FormalParameter/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value')] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration')])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getenv', 'getProperty') and *[1][self::TypeExpression and pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System')] and not(ArgumentList/StringLiteral[1][matches(@ConstValue, '^(java|user|os|file|line|path|javax|jdk|sun|com\.sun|http|https|ftp)\.|^socks')]) and (ArgumentList/* or parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('get', 'getOrDefault', 'containsKey')])] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[last()]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration')])] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[last()]/ImplementsList/ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.ApplicationContextInitializer')])] [not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1][@Name = 'main'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'])] | //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController')]] //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getProperty', 'getRequiredProperty') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.core.env.PropertyResolver')]]
